Simonian Cuckoos

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Simonian_Cuckoos

thumb 400px Itō Jakuchū]]Simonian Cuckoos are chickens descended from Simone the Fowl. Despite the name, they are not related to cuckoos. Simone the Fowl was also a cuckoo chicken, so there may be other cuckoo chicken breeds.
